strategy: Walk-Forward Kelly (f=0.25) + Tree Ensemble — AUDITED & VERIFIED 2026-03-28
data_source: Walk-forward on 934 games, 19 weeks, Kaggle GPU (P100) | TabICL + 5 tree models
audit_status: VERIFIED — raw results were inflated by 3 compounding bugs. See audit_findings below.

RAW_REPORTED_DO_NOT_USE.note: These numbers are ARTIFACTS. See audit_findings for root causes.

VERIFIED_METRICS.note_win_rate: 67% on filtered picks (24% of 934 games) is plausible but must be validated against real closing lines.
VERIFIED_METRICS.sharpe_note: Original 22.91 used sqrt(252) on WEEKLY data. Correct: sqrt(52). Even 10.4 is still inflated by the odds bug — real market Sharpe estimated 1-3.
VERIFIED_METRICS.max_drawdown_note: Reported DD uses weekly snapshots. Jan 9 intraday sequence shows ~10% drawdown within single week.

roi_with_real_market_odds.note: 67% win rate profitability is HIGHLY sensitive to avg market odds. At -120 (typical NBA line), barely positive.

flat_bet_5usd_realistic.note: 227 bets * $5 * yield. Conservative=2% yield, Realistic=14%, Optimistic=27.5%.

audit_findings.title: Circular implied-odds: model probability used as market odds
audit_findings.root_cause: When real odds CSV key does not match, code falls back to: odds = 1/(prob * 1.05). The same model probability drives both the 'market odds' and the edge calculation. Result: bets on 73% probability teams at +575 (6.75 decimal) — impossible in any real sportsbook.
audit_findings.evidence: Trades show edges of 102%, 314%, 396% — real sportsbooks cap effective edge at 3-8%.
audit_findings.fix: Add: if not real_odds: continue (skip bet, no implied fallback)

audit_findings.title: Sharpe annualization wrong: sqrt(252) applied to weekly returns
audit_findings.root_cause: sqrt(252) is the correct annualization for DAILY returns. Weekly data requires sqrt(52).

audit_findings.title: Max drawdown computed from weekly snapshots only
audit_findings.impact: Reports 1.97% when true intraday DD is ~10-15%
audit_findings.root_cause: equity_curve records one point per 7-day window. Consecutive losses within a week are invisible.
audit_findings.evidence: Jan 9 week: bankroll went 985 -> 960 -> 935 -> 910 -> 885 before recovering. ~10% intraday DD hidden.
audit_findings.fix: Record bankroll after every single bet. Compute max_dd from full per-bet series.

audit_findings.title: ATS / O/U markets: zero bets despite claim of 100% real odds
audit_findings.impact: Misses potentially strong edges in spread/total markets (research shows 5-8% ROI)
audit_findings.root_cause: nba_2025-26_odds.csv lacks 'spread' and 'total' columns. ATS/O/U code silently skips.
audit_findings.fix: Augment odds CSV via scrape_season_odds.py to include spread and total lines.

realistic_forward_estimate.basis: Brier 0.22447 vs market ~0.225 implies small but real edge. 67% win rate on filtered subset.
what_to_fix_first: 1. Remove implied-odds fallback — only bet with verified real market odds
2. Add CLV tracking — measure if we beat closing lines consistently
3. Add calibration analysis — do 70% picks win 70%?
4. Add spread/total data — ATS may be our best edge market

what_is_real: Brier 0.22447 on 19-week walk-forward — legitimate, no look-ahead bias
67% win rate on selected games — plausible, needs CLV validation
Weekly Brier range 0.167-0.301 — shows real model variance
Positive ROI direction — model genuinely outperforms random
what_is_inflated: ROI 4,470% — circular odds artifact, real is ~14-27% with real odds
Max DD 1.97% — weekly snapshots, true is ~10-15%
Avg edge 89.18% — impossible, result of model-implied 'market' odds
real_odds_pct 100% — misleading, many bets used implied fallback
monthly_pnl_note: Monthly PnL figures inherit the circular-odds bug and should not be used for sizing decisions.
equity_curve_note: Curve reflects inflated circular-odds results. Direction (upward) is meaningful; absolute values are not.
real_odds_pct_note: MISLEADING — many bets used model-implied odds fallback despite CSV being loaded. Key matching failures caused fallback to circular odds.
